name: github
description: GitHub connector — issues, PRs, releases, repos, and search via the gh CLI

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: GitHub
examples: Open a pull request for my current branch against main
Summarize the open issues on this repo grouped by label
Review PR #123 and leave a comment with my feedback

setup.title: Install the GitHub CLI
setup.detail: The Install button below can do this for you. Or grab the installer for your platform from the official site.

setup.title: Authenticate
setup.detail: Run `gh auth login` in a terminal and follow the browser prompt (choose GitHub.com → HTTPS → "Login with a web browser"). This stores your token securely in the OS keychain — no token to paste here.

setup.title: Set a default repo (optional)
setup.detail: Run `gh repo set-default` inside a cloned repo so issue/PR commands target it without a `--repo` flag. Skip this if you'll always pass `--repo owner/name`.
